goal.name: JEE Main
goal.valid_for: JEE Main 2027 (built on the 2026 NTA syllabus; re-check when NTA publishes the 2027 syllabus)
goal.video_language_note: Chapter one-shot lectures are mostly Hinglish (Hindi + English). English-only users see the same videos tagged hi-en.
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official bodies, open-licence textbooks, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted PDFs re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Video minutes are real YouTube durations with the +15% rule applied (see goal.last_link_check). Mocks and the revision allowance remain planning figures.
